fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami-area public issues, including a campaign to drive out loan sharks (wage-buyers) and discussion of usury enforcement; criticism of greyhound track operations and their economic impact; coverage and promotion of horse racing at Tropical Park and racing-season notes; nightlife and entertainment columns and advertisements; sports commentary; and crime-related reporting including references to the Biltmore jewel robbery investigation and other local law-enforcement items.
